decisions.passage:
(A) If you hate the thing you do but have to do it nonetheless, you have choice between hating and accepting. Doing it from <u>place</u> of hatred will develop hatred towards the self and others around you.

(B) They decided to visit a new <u>place</u> for their vacation this summer. The hotel was located in a beautiful area near the mountains.
decisions.stem: 밑줄 친 place가 (A)와 (B)에서 의미하는 것으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: (A) from place of hatred = 증오의 입장/관점에서, (B) visit a place = 장소.
det.analysis:
✅ ① (A) 입장 — (B) 장소 ←정답
❌ ② 뒤바뀜
❌ ③ (B)는 장소
❌ ④ (A)는 입장
